stem: How does the setting advance the plot of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: It allows the characters to witness an uncommon event.

options.label: B
options.text: It gives the characters the opportunity to identify a problem.

options.label: C
options.text: It offers the characters a chance to develop new relationships.

options.label: D
options.text: It causes the characters to feel unsafe.
